pretreatments.description: Hydrothermal pretreatment (HP) by autohydrolysis of sugarcane bagasse at 183 °C for 41 min with a liquid-to-solid ratio (LSR) of 3.94 mL g^-1.
Mechanical degradation using a hydraulic press at 9 tons pressure to extract hemicelluloses hydrolysate.
Grinding in a Wiley mill to pass through a 40-mesh (0.42 mm) sieve.
Alkaline extraction (AE) using an aqueous 0.2 mol L^-1 NaOH solution at an LSR of 10 mL g^-1 in a blunt-bladed blender at 2,800 rpm for 30 s.

Advanced oxidative pretreatment (AOP) using aqueous H2O2 and NaOH to adjust pH to 11.6, with conditions optimized via Doehlert experimental design (varying H2O2 load from 0.3 to 3.0 g_H2O2 g_SB^-1, LSR from 5 to 25 mL g^-1, and reaction time from 1 to 8 h) at 25 °C with stirring at 150 rpm.
Mechanical deconstruction of cellulose pulp fibers using a blunt-bladed blender operated at 2,800 rpm for 30 s after AOP.
